attributes.action: Remove planning permission requirements for front window shading
attributes.additional_details:
Heatwaves kill thousands and make millions miserable. You can build a car port without planning permission, but shading front windows requires planning permission costing £548 plus fees.

It shouldn’t be easier to shade a car than a child’s bedroom. Expand permitted development rights to allow external shading on front walls. Shutters, brise soleil, awnings, Dutch canopies are all great options. Passive cooling is cheaper than air conditioning too.
attributes.background: Shading windows is the simplest way to keep a house cool, yet installing external shading on the front of a UK house requires costly planning permission. This red tape puts lives, health and happiness at risk. Expand permitted development rights to allow external shading. It’s the cool thing to do.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Remove the need for planning permission for external shutters on properties" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778193

You may also be interested in this petition: "Make solar-shading improvements a permitted development for homes and workplaces" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776625
